info.name: Fleet Flow API Collection
info.description: Production-grade Postman collection for Fleet Flow microservices platform (Fleet Partner, Vehicle, Driver, Assignment, Shipment, and User Services). Uses parameterized base URLs for seamless transition to API Gateway.

variable.description: Fleet Partner Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)
Shipment Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)
User Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)
Tracking Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)
Matching & Offer Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)
Notification Service Base URL (change to http://localhost:8080 when using API Gateway)

item.name: 3. User Service
item.description: APIs managing customer profiles, verification statuses, and saved addresses.

item.name: 4. Tracking Service
item.description: Driver live tracking sessions, GPS ingestion, presence, and nearby driver geospatial lookup.

item.name: 5. Matching & Offer Service
item.description: APIs for Delivery Offers, FCFS Job Claiming, and Driver Dispatching.

item.name: 6. Notification Service
item.description: APIs managing Device FCM Token Registrations and Push Notification Delivery History.
